texts.preamble: M/S Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages ... vs The State Of Jharkhand And Other .... ... on 16 June, 2023 Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi 1 In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi ---- Cr.M.P. No. 2111 of 2012 ---- M/s Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Private Limited .... Petitioner -- Versus -- The State of Jharkhand and Other .... Opposite Parties ---- Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi --- For the Petitioner :- Mr. Indrajit Sinha, Advocate For the State :- Ms Kumari Rashmi, Advocate ----
texts.facts: 2. This petition has been filed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding in connection with PFA Case No.48 of 2004 including the order whereby the discharge petition filed by the petitioner has been rejected dated 07.07.2012 by learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad, pending before the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad. 4. The learned court has been pleased to take cognizance under section 16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1950 and summoned the petitioner to face the trial.
texts.arguments: He submits that the product of Thumps Up was seized by the public analyst at Gomoh M/S Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages ... vs The State Of Jharkhand And Other .... ... on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131690551/ 1 railway station. He submits that however the public analyst of Bihar has given the report which is not acceptable in view of section 8 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1950. The contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner has not been demolished by the argument made by the learned counsel for the respondent.
texts.petitioner_arguments: He submits that the product of Thumps Up was seized by the public analyst at Gomoh M/S Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages ... vs The State Of Jharkhand And Other .... ... on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131690551/ 1 railway station. The contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner has not been demolished by the argument made by the learned counsel for the respondent.
